welcome_text: Hello! My name is Ingrid Bianchi
who_i_am: From Commercial Strategist to Full Stack Developer with Product Vision

I used to live among campaigns, multidisciplinary teams, and marketing dashboards—always searching for the most efficient way to connect with people. Then one day I thought: “What if I bring that obsession with understanding users into the tech world?

Today, I design and build digital solutions that don’t just work—they resonate. I blend solid backend development with user-centered UX/UI design, translating business needs into scalable, secure, and maintainable technology.

My edge: a 360° vision that fuses empathy, architecture, and strategy. I analyze the market, the competition, and the context before writing a single line of code. With experience in e-commerce, CRM, bots, APIs, and automation, every project I touch aims for real impact.
I’m passionate about turning ideas into interactive systems that solve problems, engage users, and evolve. Every bug fixed, every flow optimized, is a step toward something greater.
